newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes steady in active market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes steady in active market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed mostly steady at 42.5420/5430 to the dollar in interbank trading, compared with Sunday's close at 42.5400/5440, dealers said.
They said market was active with international markets reopening after weekend. The local unit quoted at 42.5400/5470 in early trade but deals were mostly done at the closing level.
"There was significant demand (of dollars) but supply was also adequate. Some foreign banks offered large amount," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates ended flat at 5.0 to 5.5 percent, dealers said.
